description: This file defines the DecodingEventStreamIterator class, which implements an iterator to decode, validate, and parse individual events from a binary-encoded AWS event stream.

classes.name: DecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for decoding and validating a binary-encoded AWS event stream, providing individual events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a stream and rewinds to the first event.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses headers from the event stream based on header bytes.

methods.name: parsePrelude
methods.description: Parses the prelude section of an event, including CRC validation.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Decodes a single event from the stream, including headers, payload, and checksum validation.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next event in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream to the beginning and parses the first event.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the stream size.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the stream and updates the hash context.

methods.name: uintToInt
methods.description: Converts unsigned integers to signed integers based on size.

methods.name: unpackInt64
methods.description: Unpacks 8-byte data into a 64-bit integer, handling PHP version differences.

methods.name: decodeBytes
methods.description: Decodes a byte array with variable length.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a string with variable length.
